source_files: backtest/lib/filters.py (evaluate_bearish_setup, evaluate_bullish_setup -- the actual filter checklist)
scoring_and_threshold_logic.mechanism: Each side (BEAR=10 filters, BULL=11 filters) runs a checklist; every failed filter appends its number to a `blockers` list. `passed = len(blockers) == 0` -- NOT a separate score cutoff. `bear_score = 10 - len(blockers) - htf_disagree_demerit`; `bull_score = 11 - len(blockers) - htf_disagree_demerit`. The trigger-count check is ITSELF one of the filters (bear filter 10, bull filter 11): `if len(triggers) < min_triggers: blockers.append(<10|11>)`, ELSE (elif) `if no trigger is level-tied: blockers.append(<10|11>)`. So passing requires BOTH the trigger-count threshold AND at least one level-tied trigger -- exactly the doctrine fact the mission named. A HOLD verdict from engine_cli.decide_payload means BOTH sides had >=1 blocker (`neither side passed scoring`); routing/gate logic (SKIP_<GATE>) only runs for a side that already passed scoring, so HOLD rows never reach the 15 entry gates at all.
scoring_and_threshold_logic.score_deficit_is_exact: PROOF: on a HOLD tick both sides have blockers>=1 by definition. In live production only the htf-disagree demerit is ever active (vix_soft_mode/allow_one_blocker/bearish_reversal_bypass are never forwarded by heartbeat_core.py._build_payload, so those demerits are structurally 0 live). score_deficit = blockers + demerit >= 1. Therefore deficit==1 ALWAYS means exactly ONE blocking filter and ZERO demerit -- there is no ambiguity in the '1 point from passing' population.

trigger_autopsy_structural_impossibility.claim: On a sustained, no-retest trend, the ENTIRE bull trigger vocabulary is structurally untriggerable by construction, once >3 bars have elapsed since the last ribbon flip and price has moved away from every known level.

per_trigger_mechanism.ribbon_flip: detect_ribbon_flip_bullish (backtest/lib/filters.py:775) requires the CURRENT bar's stack == BULL AND at least one of the prior RIBBON_FLIP_LOOKBACK_BARS=3 bars != BULL. Once the ribbon has been BULL for >3 consecutive bars (15+ minutes), this is mathematically False for every subsequent bar until the NEXT flip event -- it is a one-shot transition signal, not a state.
per_trigger_mechanism.level_reclaim: detect_level_reclaim (filters.py:758) requires bar.low < level < bar.close for some pre-identified level in levels_active -- i.e. price must physically dip back down and touch a known S/R level THIS bar. A trend that has moved away from all known levels and keeps making new highs without pulling back never satisfies this.
per_trigger_mechanism.confluence: detect_confluence (filters.py:741) is a pure function of reclaim_level -- if level_reclaim is None, confluence is unconditionally None. It has no independent firing path.
per_trigger_mechanism.sequence_reclaim: detect_sequence_reclaim (filters.py:487) requires a level_state with role== 'broken_to_support' AND >=3 bounce_history entries of progressively higher lows -- i.e. price must have OSCILLATED around one specific broken level at least 3 times. A smooth away-trending move produces no such history.

trigger_autopsy_structural_impossibility.conclusion: There is no trigger in the vocabulary for 'sustained directional continuation without a pullback' (no VWAP-hold, no N-consecutive-same-side-bars, no momentum/ADX-persistence trigger). This is a genuine coverage hole in the trigger CATEGORY, not a mis-set threshold on an existing one.

what_would_justify_a_threshold_change.explicitly_not_recommended: Lowering filter_10_min_triggers_bear/bull or relaxing the level-tied requirement.
